_comment: The cg26n options as overrides, for applying them to the cg26m build. In the cg26n build they are already the defaults (see cg26n.env). Keys starting with _ are ignored by scripts/merge_overrides.py.
_inf_cf_maxgrow: growth cap: accumulated edits kept within 1.5x the norm of the unedited matrix (local: final BPC 2.079 vs 2.104 uncapped, 2.073 without edits)
_inf_cf_min_others: the edit batch shrinks so 16 live conclusions are kept back to centre the keys on; no edit below 8 + 16 live conclusions (GPU cg26m rolled back edits at visits 3-4 at +5.9 and +7.9 BPC)
_inf_sleep_adapt: adaptive sleep: NREM ends at write convergence, REM cycles end at closure or falling yield, at most 6 (local: -0.014 / 2.068 vs -0.012 / 2.073, REM conclusions 36 vs 25, run time -17%)
_pinned_12nov: old defaults pinned when distillation, mlp_out writes and the capacity pool became defaults (11 Nov), so this preset reproduces its run
_pinned_rule_world: rule world (on by default from 11 Nov evening) pinned off so this preset reproduces its run
